description: This file implements cache manipulation routines for a Linux kernel bootloader, specifically handling cache flushing and invalidation for ARM architecture based on Atheros boards. It includes functions for flushing cache lines within a specified memory range, utilizing inline assembly for cache operations.

methods.name: void flush_cache(unsigned long start_addr,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Flushes and invalidates cache lines over a specified memory range to ensure data coherency during system boot.
